resolution.note: scope.ts: heredoc bodies stripped, operators inside quotes masked, relative targets resolved after each cd segment; new scope test fails on the old code (exit 1) and passes now (14/14)

title: Main-checkout guard refuses only real main-checkout writes
body:
Source: lane report for #1169/#1172 (2026-11-16): the main-checkout guard from #1158 (src/hook/scope.ts) refused krn-lane Bash calls that wrote nothing in the main checkout: heredoc bodies parsed as commands, `>` inside quoted `'<task-id>'` placeholders read as redirects, and relative redirect targets resolved against the payload cwd instead of the `cd <worktree> &&` that precedes them.
Outcome: judge() returns no refusal for a krn-lane Bash call whose only main-checkout matches come from heredoc bodies, quoted text, or relative paths after `cd <own worktree>`; a real `sed -i <main>/src/x.ts` still gets the refusal.
Why: a false refusal breaks every lane and teaches agents to work around the guard.
Proof: test/hook/scope.test.ts cases for the three shapes return no refusal; the existing refusal cases still refuse.
Files: src/hook/scope.ts, test/hook/scope.test.ts
